The story hasn't actually been implemented — the prior "report" was fabricated (empty TDD/Gates/Changes sections, no diff, no new tests). I'd do the real work per spec.md's Behavior section, matching the review's fixes exactly:

1. **src/store/verify.ts**
   - Add a `BoundaryDeclaration` tri-state type: `{kind:"none"}` | `{kind:"unparseable"}` | `{kind:"patterns", patterns:string[]}`.
   - Rewrite `declaredBoundary(dir)` (currently :354-378) to: collect every heading matching `/^#{1,6}\s+.*boundary/i` as a candidate; order candidates house-form-first (`/\b(frozen\s+)?pr\s+boundary\b/i`) then document order; for each candidate's section (heading → next heading of any level), compute `sectionPatterns(lines, headingIdx)` and return the first non-empty result as `{kind:"patterns",...}`; if candidates exist but none yield patterns, return `{kind:"unparseable"}`; if no candidate at all (or no spec.md), return `{kind:"none"}`.
   - Add `sectionPatterns(lines, headingIdx)`: union of (a) the section's first fenced block via a new `fencePatterns(body)` helper — trim, drop empty, drop whole-line `#`, otherwise cut at first `/\s+#/` and re-trim/drop-if-empty (fixes #129, preserves `a#b.md`) — and (b) the section's first markdown table whose header's first cell (stripped of backticks/emphasis) equals `Path` case-insensitively, pulling every backticked token from each body row's first cell and ignoring prose/other tables (rejects `| Not here | Owner |`).
   - Update `boundaryCheck` (:401-419): branch on `declared.kind` — `"none"` → unchanged `{ran:false,pass:true,detail:"no boundary declared"}`; `"unparseable"` → new `{ran:true,pass:true,detail:BOUNDARY_ADVISORY}` naming the problem and remedy, never `pass:false`; `"patterns"` → existing stray computation, plus on the failing branch append declared patterns that matched zero changed files to the detail.
   - Add a `BOUNDARY_ADVISORY` constant with wording matching `/nothing parseable|declares nothing/`.
   - Update `provenanceCheck` (:704-716): change the guard to `declared.kind !== "patterns"` so both `none` and `unparseable` stay `{ran:false,pass:true,detail:"no boundary declared"}`.
   - Correct `ledgerBlock`'s doc comment (:513-516) to state the deliberate divergence (generated single-heading YAML input; `#` must not be stripped because it's YAML's own comment syntax) instead of claiming it mirrors `declaredBoundary`. No behavior change to `ledgerBlock` itself.

2. **test/verify.test.ts** — add one failing-then-passing test per AC:
   - AC-V-BOUNDARY-HIJACK (AC-001): prose heading above real `## PR boundary` fence, stray file outside boundary → exit 1, `/changed outside declared boundary: .*stray/`, no `"no boundary declared"`.
   - AC-002: H1 title containing "boundary" + real fence, in-boundary change → `--json` `boundary.ran===true && pass===true`.
   - AC-V-BOUNDARY-TABLE (AC-003/AC-004): `| Path | Change |` table form — in-boundary passes, out-of-boundary fails naming the stray.
   - AC-005: negative `| Not here | Owner |` table → advisory pass, no false stray.
   - AC-V-BOUNDARY-COMMENT (AC-006): `allowed/x.md   # only the CLI` admitted; `allowed/a#b.md` admitted intact.
   - AC-007: whole-line `# comment` alongside a real pattern — in-boundary passes, out-of-boundary still fails.
   - AC-V-BOUNDARY-ADVISORY (AC-008): heading with nothing parseable → exit 0, `boundary.ran===true && pass===true`, detail matches advisory regex.
   - AC-009: no boundary-matching heading at all → `boundary.ran===false`, detail exactly `"no boundary declared"`; verify existing AC-PROV-BOUNDARY (~:976) stays green.
   - AC-010: declares `allowed/` and `never-touched/`, only a stray file changes → failure detail contains `never-touched/`.
   - AC-PROV-HIJACK (AC-011): hijack fixture + `require_commit_provenance:true` + empty `links.commits` → provenance fails, `err` matches `/links\.commits is empty/` and `/record-links/`.
   - AC-012: unparseable heading + `require_commit_provenance:true` → `provenance.ran===false` with exact skip detail while `boundary.ran===true`.
   - AC-013: `#`-commented YAML line inside the ledger fence still round-trips through `parseYaml`.

3. **CHANGELOG.md** — add a `### Fixed` entry under `[Unreleased]` covering #135 and #129, noting the previously-dormant boundary check now runs on table-form specs (NF-002 honesty note).

4. **dist/cli.js**, **dist/index.js** — rebuild the tracked bundle from the fixed `src/` so the shipped CLI actually carries the fix (these are tracked build artifacts in this repo, not generated at install time).

5. **.bklg/support/fix-gate-honesty-sweep/issues-135-129-declared-boundary-parse/implementation-report.md** — replace the empty template with a report reflecting the real work: fill the TDD Evidence table with the actual AC→test mapping, record real commit SHAs, describe the Changes, and paste the genuine `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` output into Gates. Then run `redkiln record-links` with the real checkpoint SHA — this must be done through the normal redkiln flow, not by hand-editing item frontmatter.

I would not hand-edit story.md/spec.md stage frontmatter — stage transitions go through `redkiln advance`, which is outside the scope of raw file edits.
